description: ProdKB — Complete application observability: services health, HTTP traffic, latency, errors, database, Redis, Node.js runtime, and live logs.

panels.title: Backend API
panels.description: Indicates if the main Node.js backend server is online and responding.

panels.title: SLA Worker
panels.description: Indicates if the background worker responsible for SLA enforcement is running.

panels.title: Redis
panels.description: Redis cache connection status (used for auth, rate limiting).

panels.title: Total Requests (24h)
panels.description: Total number of HTTP requests processed in the last 24 hours.

panels.title: Users & Connections
panels.description: Shows the active authenticated users (sessions) and the raw open TCP HTTP connections.

panels.title: Error Rate (5m)
panels.description: Percentage of requests returning an error (4xx or 5xx). A spike indicates users are experiencing failures.

panels.title: P95 Latency (5m)
panels.description: The time it takes for 95% of requests to complete. Spikes mean users are experiencing slow loads.

panels.title: Req/s (5m avg)
panels.description: Current application traffic volume (Requests per second).

title: ProdKB Health & Metrics
